description: This file is a unit test class for the HolidayAPI in the OrangeHRM leave module. It contains test cases for CRUD operations and validation rules of the HolidayAPI, involving mocks of data access objects and services, and testing the API response normalization.

classes.name: HolidayAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the HolidayAPI, testing CRUD operations, validation rules, and data normalization for holiday records within OrangeHRM's leave module.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads fixture data for holidays from a YAML file into the test database.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a single holiday record via the getOne() method, including mocking DAO and service layers.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests the validation rules for the getOne API endpoint.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing holiday record via the API, with mocked DAO and service layers.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Tests validation rules for updating a holiday record.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a holiday record through the API, expecting a not found exception if record does not exist.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests validation rules for deleting holiday records.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new holiday record via the API, including fixture loading and mocking DAO/service layers.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Tests validation rules for creating a holiday record.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of holidays with filtering and verifies normalization.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Tests validation rules for retrieving multiple holidays.
